title: Mallworld more tech
content: over the past few months i've noticed my phone is now in my dream (iphone) i can see the screen properly and can even read clearly.. this is completely new and I found it so bizzare as Inknow my whole life (35 years) i've never been able to read anything in a dream and their certainty were no phones. I have now second night in a row dreamt I was in mallworld only it's different to my usual mallworld... 1st night I was trying to escape whatever this place is i've been in all my dreams.. somewhere i'm being controlled and almost imprisoned... I finally managed to escape and entered a casino.. first time i've seen a casino in this world... lots of people playing but I knew i wasn't one of them as they were the higher class almost one man asked me to plug in.. and he gave me like a usb device that had everyone's usb style thing plugged in...I didn't have one so I took someone's out and plugged in and my dream ended last night I ended up back in the casino mall but was walking around observing anyone know what's going on? why the changes? has this happened to anyone else??
